description: This is a Python script for processing component/entity definitions, generating C++ code via templates, and managing file outputs for a software project. It includes classes for message and component handling, dependency resolution, and YAML parsing.

classes.name: CommonAttribute
classes.description: Represents a common attribute with methods to generate declaration and initializer strings.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a message with name and arguments, providing methods for handler and tuple type generation.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Named tuple for component parameters including name, type, and default value.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents a component with parameters, messages, dependencies, and methods for dependency gathering and code generation.

classes.name: Entity
classes.description: Represents an entity composed of components, managing dependencies, parameters, and message handling.

classes.name: PreprocessingLoader
classes.description: Custom Jinja2 loader that preprocesses templates to remove indentation and comments.

classes.name: OrderedLoader
classes.description: Custom YAML loader that preserves order using OrderedDict.

methods.name: convert_params
methods.description: Converts parameter default values to string representations suitable for code generation.

methods.name: load_general
methods.description: Loads general definitions including common attributes and mandatory components.

methods.name: load_components
methods.description: Loads component definitions, including parameters, messages, and dependencies.

methods.name: load_entities
methods.description: Loads entity definitions and their component composition.

methods.name: topo_sort_components
methods.description: Performs topological sort on components based on dependencies.

methods.name: parse_definitions
methods.description: Parses and links all definitions from the YAML input, resolving dependencies and ordering.
